merchant/30209.htm.text: Dye Merchant Colleen: Welcome! Our shop specializes in weapons. Isn't the power of pigments amazing? Even an outstanding adventurer may need something we carry in our shop. Have a look!

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30209-pk.htm.text: Dye Merchant Colleen: I do not wish to bestow the power of magic to one like yourself. Leave this place at once.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
